settings.drift: the fixture program with the json adapter, each run 2% slower than the one before, 10 rounds a side, no warm-up, no added rounds
settings.harness: the real harnesses through jvq run with their adapters: pytest-benchmark, Google Benchmark (its Python bindings), vitest bench and Rust's criterion, each timing a loop whose length is set per commit; 10 rounds to start, up to 30
settings.noisy: the Go fixture benchmark (20 ms a round, 10 rounds to start, up to 30), beside a process keeping 2 of the 4 CPUs busy and churning through 512 MB
settings.python: a Python script running a 800000-round loop: timed whole by the time adapter, or timing 5 batches of a tenth of it with the json adapter; 10 rounds to start, up to 30
